title: 4 dead, 2 in life-threatening condition after car crash in Puslinch, Ont.
summary: Four people are dead and two others suffered life-threatening injuries after a single-vehicle crash in Puslinch early Saturday, according to Ontario Provincial Police

image.caption: Officers were called to the area of Watson Road S., north of Wellington Road 34, shortly after 1:30 a.m., Ontario Provincial Police said in a post to social media platform X. (Andrew Collins/CBC)

blocks.text: Four people are dead and two others suffered life-threatening injuries after a single-vehicle crash in Puslinch early Saturday, according to Ontario Provincial Police
Watson Road S. to remain closed until Saturday evening between Wellington Road 34 and Maltby Road
Officers responded shortly after 1:30 a.m. to the area of Watson Road S., north of Wellington Road 34 — a rural area southwest of Guelph — OPP said in a post to social media platform X.
Six people were in the car, police said. Four were pronounced dead and two remain in life-threatening condition in hospital, according to an update posted to X.
Officers planned to share more information at a news conference Sunday morning.
Watson Road S. was fully closed between Wellington Road 34 and Maltby Road and would remain closed for the next six to eight hours, police said shortly before noon.
Anyone with information is asked to contact police.
